text: This report recommends approval of a Rental Housing Demolition application which proposes to demolish and replace 29 rental dwelling units located at 47 and 65 Huntley Street, 3 and 11 Selby Street and 2, 8, 12, and 16 Linden Street. The proposal includes a Tenant Assistance Plan that addresses the right of existing tenants to return to replacement rental units at similar rents and provides financial compensation to mitigate hardship. The proposed development on the site at 47-65 Huntley Street, 1-11 Selby Street and 2-18 and 24-26 Linden Street is the subject of a related Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendment application (21 227527 STE 13 OZ) which was appealed to the Ontario Land Tribunal (OLT). City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1.
